collection.title: Rover Mini 1988 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Rover Mini 1988 to 2000 will fit, this model requires a 11" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
